label: TP
reason: User-supplied query string parameter flows directly to bar via doSomething. The conditional replacement logic replaces characters starting at index (len - "Z".length()). Since "Z" has length 1, this starts at len-1. However, the replace call uses substring indices (len-1, len), which covers only the last character. If the input contains '<script>' tags anywhere other than the very last character, they remain unescaped and reach the HTML sink (writer.println). Thus, XSS is possible.

evidence.note: Parameter extracted from query string, decoded, passed to doSomething, returned as bar, printed to response; replacement logic only affects last char leaving potential XSS vectors intact
